tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/ProfiniteCohomolo.summary: Mathlib supplies the canonical carrier and compatible-pair functoriality (continuousCohomology, homogeneousCochains, cochainsMap/cocyclesMap/map with map_id and map_comp, and ContinuousCohomology.zeroIso), and Tau Ceti has already built almost the whole low-degree half of the roadmap: the coefficient theory and continuous sections of Layer 0, the smooth-discrete dictionary and named res/infl/coeffMap of Layer 1, the complete explicit complex with its functoriality and conjugation homotopies (Layer 2), the discrete comparison in all three degrees (Layer 3), the finite-quotient system with the degree-0 and degree-1 colimits (Layer 4), the long exact sequence through degree 2 with its naturality (Layer 5), corestriction in degrees 0-2 with change-of-transversal and cor∘res (Layer 6), the coinduced module with exactness plus Shapiro in degrees 0 and 1 (Layer 7), all six cup shapes with associativity, graded commutativity, restriction, inflation and the projection formula (Layer 8), and the Kummer sequence, cocycle and class map (Layer 9). What is genuinely missing is the canonical-model half and the multiplicative theory: the degree-1 and degree-2 comparison with continuousCohomology, the degree-2 colimit universality and all coefficient-colimit statements, the transgression and five-term sequence, transitivity and Mackey for corestriction, Shapiro in degree 2 with its naturality and the coinduction adjunction, the connecting-map cup identities and the Bockstein, profinite Hilbert 90 and hence the Kummer isomorphism and the whole galois* field-extension bridge. Layers 10 to 13 are essentially unbuilt: there is no all-degree long exact sequence, corestriction, Shapiro, dimension shifting or torsion statement, no cohomological dimension of a profinite group at all, no all-degree graded cup product, and no Evens norm — though Tau Ceti's TauCeti.WreathProduct already supplies the permutation wreath product that Layer 13's first milestone asks Mathlib's regular version to be generalized to.

tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/StablePeriodicCur.summary: The libraries supply the foundations of this roadmap but almost none of its content. Tau Ceti already has the whole generic ideal-quotient construction (TauCeti.MorphismIdeal with its congruence, the quotient through Mathlib's CategoryTheory.Quotient, the hom-group identification and the factorization criterion), the exact-structure package with relative projectives and injectives, enough of each, and the Frobenius exact predicate with the split example, and a complete finite-dimensional Frobenius-algebra theory (Frobenius and symmetric functionals, the equivalence with A ≅ A⁺, the Nakayama automorphism, and two-sided self-injectivity); Mathlib supplies the preadditive/linear quotient API, DifferentialObject, HomologicalComplex over an arbitrary ComplexShape (so ZMod n indexing is expressible), the Pretriangulated/IsTriangulated interfaces, triangulated envelopes and Verdier localization, and Localization.fac. What is genuinely missing is everything the roadmap is about: the object-generated factoring ideal and hence `Stable E`, Happel's triangulation, self-injective module categories, total acyclicity, Gorenstein-projectives, singularity categories and Buchweitz's equivalence, the periodic categories K_n and D_n with their compression, orbit category and Stai hull, curved DG algebras and modules (Tau Ceti's A∞/DG theory is explicitly uncurved), derived categories of the second kind with Positselski's comparisons, and matrix factorizations with the Eisenbud and Orlov theorems. The nearest existing fragments are the ε-periodic projective resolution over the dual numbers, which is the n = 2 case of the flagship example and already proves the ker = im acyclicity that Layer 4's acceptance test needs, and the finite-resolution/syzygy API in the exact-structure package.

AutomorphicPadicLFunctions.summary: Essentially none of this roadmap is in the libraries, and the gap is structural rather than a matter of missing lemmas. What exists is the finite-level arithmetic input and the one-variable p-adic analysis: Tau Ceti has ray class groups for a general modulus with finiteness, class-number and exactness results and the Artin symbol on ideals prime to the conductor, and Mathlib has the adele ring and idele class group, Bernoulli numbers, the Riemann/Hurwitz zeta and Dirichlet L-functions with their values at non-positive integers, classical Eisenstein series with q-expansions, and — most relevantly — abstract measures on ℤ_p with the Mahler basis and the Amice transform, which is the Iwasawa algebra in one variable. Missing is everything the roadmap constructs: the p-power-conductor inverse limit and its character space, Hecke characters with infinity types and p-adic avatars, distributions on ray-class quotients and the conditional construction principle, all of the cohomological GL₂/F and overconvergent BSW theory, Deligne–Ribet and Katz, Hsieh's anticyclotomic distribution, and the unitary-group EHLS and Eischen–Wan constructions. There is no Shimura variety, no Hilbert modular form, no Hida family and no p-adic L-function of any kind at this pin.
